roadmap.title: Story · Chapter 1
roadmap.note: Take Lucia's balcony meditation before Tourist Trap; make a manual save first.

roadmap.title: Story · Chapter 2
roadmap.note: Rob Kingpin Bowling when it is marked; unlock Moses and the real-estate app.

roadmap.title: Story · Chapter 3
roadmap.note: Do Race Against Yago at once (timed); collect the Snap Gun and Dye Pack Jammer.

roadmap.title: Story · Chapter 4
roadmap.note: Play That's Where The Money Is… to open the bank vaults.

roadmap.title: Story · Final chapter
roadmap.note: Manual save before the last mission; free roam continues after it.

roadmap.title: Strands & strangers
roadmap.note: Finish Kenton, Billy, Andy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and 8 stranger strands.

roadmap.title: Collectibles & exploration
roadmap.note: Meditations, card sets, WAiNK scans, vehicle scans, map fog.

roadmap.title: Activities
roadmap.note: Shooting ranges, drone races, races, stunts, challenges.

roadmap.title: Crime & cleanup
roadmap.note: Gang operations, laundering, shops, garages, one-off stunts.

roadmap.title: 100% and platinum
roadmap.note: Close the in-game 100% checklist; the platinum follows.

pointsOfNoReturn.what: Lucia's balcony meditation is offered — take it.
Chains missions with no free roam; balcony meditation and Chapter 1 cash are lost.
Rob the bowling alley while the job is on the map.
Timed — do it at once for Strangers & Freaks.
Manual save: several endings, no mission replay.
Permanent once reached; trophies still fine.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops by itself once the other 54 trophies are in. Every trophy is single-player and offline, and the guides put the whole run at roughly 200 hours with a difficulty near 4/10.

steps.text: Play the story with side content as it appears (about 60–80 h).
Clear the in-game 100% checklist and 50+ challenges (about 100 h).
Mop up stranger strands and one-off trophies; nothing needs online play.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Gone Fishing is the opening story mission of Chapter 1, so this unlocks as soon as you finish it. It cannot be skipped.

steps.text: Start a new game and finish the first main mission, Gone Fishing.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: A story trophy that arrives once Chapter 1 is behind you. Before you let the chapter end, take Lucia's balcony meditation and move cash into family savings, because Tourist Trap starts a chain of missions you can't leave and Chapter 1 cash does not carry over.

steps.text: Before Tourist Trap: do Lucia's balcony meditation and bank spare cash.
Finish Chapter 1; the trophy pops after the first Chapter 2 mission, What's in the Bag?

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unlocks when Chapter 2 ends; the guides report it popping as Chapter 3 opens with Welcome to Vice City. Checking Out closes the chapter, so a cash buffer saved before it is advised.

steps.text: Have about $15,000 in savings before Checking Out, the Chapter 2 finale.
Play on into Chapter 3; the trophy follows its first mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Comes with the end of Chapter 3, after the first two Chapter 4 missions. Clear Race Against Yago while you are in Chapter 3, because it is on a timer.

steps.text: Clear the timed Race Against Yago when it appears.
Finish Chapter 3 and the first two Chapter 4 missions.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story progress; Chapter 4 closes with Starting From Zero. Play the optional That's Where The Money Is… while you are here, since it opens the bank vaults for Maximum Withdrawal.

steps.text: Take the optional That's Where The Money Is… for the vaults.
Finish Chapter 4's last mission, Starting From Zero.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold for beating the last story mission. Free roam carries on afterwards, so nothing else is locked out by the ending, but the story has several endings and no mission replay: keep a manual save from just before it.

steps.text: Make a manual save before the final mission (endings differ, no replay).
Beat the final mission; free roam resumes after the credits.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a required Chapter 2 mission; the trophy unlocks while you play it.

steps.text: Progress Chapter 2 until Breakfast Run and complete it.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a main Chapter 3 job; finishing it unlocks the trophy automatically.

steps.text: Follow Chapter 3 to The Cartel Heist and complete it.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play is a Chapter 4 story mission; the trophy comes with it.

steps.text: Reach Child's Play in Chapter 4 and finish it.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is another required Chapter 4 mission; the trophy cannot be missed.

steps.text: Play Chapter 4 through Headliners.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 story job at the airport; the trophy is awarded when it ends.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory belongs to the last chapter; it unlocks on the way to the final mission.

steps.text: Play Chapter 5 up to and through Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The longest trophy. The in-game checklist mixes full requirements (every robbery incl. 8 vaults and 39 gang operations, underwater finds, all shooting-range golds, all drone races, 15 Bret target decks) with partial ones (200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 15 of 18 meditations, 300 of 397 stunts, 70 of 80 challenges, 100 WAiNK scans). PowerPyx and GTABase say no checklist item is missable.

steps.text: Open the checklist after the credits and sort by what is fully required.
Clear the full categories first: robberies, vaults, gang ops, ranges, drone races.
Top up the partial categories to their thresholds (e.g. 300/397 stunts).

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count: stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife flights and base jumps. Under-bridge flights are the quickest to farm. Go on to 300 if you are chasing 100%.

steps.text: Take a small plane or helicopter and chain under-bridge flights.
Add stunt jumps, knife flights and base jumps as you pass them.
Stop at 250 for the trophy, or push to 300 for the checklist.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Nine activity types count: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting-range challenge, pool, basketball (one basket is enough), an arcade game, a race win (car race, race challenge or drone race) and a stunt. Most come up during normal play.

steps.text: Tick off fishing, hunting, golf, pool and one basketball basket.
Add a range challenge, an arcade game, a race win and a stunt.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: 42 gold medals across two ranges: Griffin Shooting Range in north-west Vice City (6 timed courses, 18 golds) and Rodgers Ranch north-east of Port Gellhorn (6 scored courses, 24 golds). Each range needs a $5 waiver from the clerk before its challenges show on the map.

steps.text: Buy the $5 waiver from the clerk at each range.
Griffin: 3-Point, Hook, Loop, Maze, Compound, Villa — 18 golds, timed.
Rodgers Ranch: Market, Zombie, Hunting, Saloon, Cops & Robbers, Alien — 24 golds, score-based.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: There are 14 Top Fun locations with three drone races each (42 in all). One win per location is enough for the trophy; beating par in the first two races opens the third.

steps.text: Visit each of the 14 Top Fun locations and win one drone race there.
Beat par on races 1–2 to open race 3 (all 42 are needed for 100%).

b.text: Map marks 42 separate drone time-trial spots.

differ.call: Track 14 locations; the 42 are the races inside them.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: 40 unique races are marked with blue icons under Map > Activities > Racing; winning the same race twice counts once. Permanent tracks include Boone Speedway, Gellhorn Raceway and Ambrosia Raceway Park.

steps.text: Filter the map to Racing and work through the blue race icons.
Win 20 distinct races; repeat wins don't add progress.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, Cal sends a text that marks a fishing spot (PowerPyx places it west of Key Lento). Go there and out-fish him in his challenge.

steps.text: Finish Feng Shui in Chapter 1 and read Cal's text.
Travel to the marked spot and win Cal's fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish any one of four games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind on the TV console at Jason's place, or Bang For Your Buck in arcade cabinets around Leonida. Easiest to grab in Chapter 1 while the home console is right there.
trophies.pointOfNoReturn: Home console: end of Chapter 1 per one guide; cabinets stay available.

steps.text: Play one of the three games on the home console in Chapter 1.
Missed it? Finish Bang For Your Buck at any arcade cabinet.

a.text: Home-console games are gone after Chapter 1.

b.text: The console returns in Chapter 3, and cabinets are always there.

differ.call: Not missable: cabinets keep it open. Do it in Ch 1 anyway.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's strand is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3 in Belville. It has five quests; the fifth, Puff Puff Pass, awards the trophy. It does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

steps.text: As Lucia, meet Andy in Belville once Chapter 3 marks him.
Clear all five of his quests, ending with Puff Puff Pass.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton hires you after Island Dreams in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from seven shipwrecks with the metal detector (purple chest markers). His jobs pause when Chapter 1 ends and come back later.
trophies.pointOfNoReturn: None: Kenton's dives pause after Chapter 1 and return later.

steps.text: Meet Kenton after Island Dreams (Chapter 1).
Dive the seven wrecks with the metal detector at purple markers.
If he goes quiet after Chapter 1, keep playing; he returns.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy appears at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after Coffee Break (Chapter 2). Five jobs; the fifth, Hometown Heroes, gives the trophy. Not a Strangers & Freaks strand.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, go to the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Work through Billy's five jobs up to Hometown Heroes.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Eight qualifying stranger strands are needed. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count; Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie are confirmed not to. The other four qualifying strands were not yet named by any guide we read. Yago's Chapter 3 race is timed, so do it on sight.
trophies.pointOfNoReturn: Race Against Yago (Chapter 3) expires on a timer.

steps.text: Do Race Against Yago the moment it appears in Chapter 3.
Finish Kirk's, Kyle's, Yago's and Pilot Pete's strands.
Find four more stranger strands (not Andy/Billy/Tyrone).

a.text: At risk: Yago's timed race can lock his strand.

b.text: Not listed as missable; everything stays open after the story.

differ.call: WATCH — do Yago's race immediately; treat as not missable otherwise.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after Clonin' Keys in Chapter 3, which hands you the Key Cloner. Steal and deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his west Vice City garage.

steps.text: Finish Clonin' Keys (Chapter 3) to get the Key Cloner.
Deliver all 16 Wish List cars to Randy's garage in west Vice City.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only strand from Chapter 3: destroy the synthetic-drug labs Tyrone marks in purple around Vice City, then finish his last job.

steps.text: As Jason, take Tyrone's work once Chapter 3 marks him.
Destroy every purple-marked lab, then complete his final job.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: 18 meditations at 10 places; most spots count once for Jason and once for Lucia. The first, Lucia's balcony session at Jason's house, vanishes when Chapter 1 ends and nobody has confirmed whether the trophy needs it — so take it.
trophies.pointOfNoReturn: Starting Tourist Trap (late Chapter 1) — the balcony meditation is lost.

steps.text: Ch 1: after Down to Earth, accept Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house.
Save manually before Tourist Trap; it chains missions with no free roam.
After Coffee Break, meditate at each spot as Jason and as Lucia (+2 per stop).
Finish on the Mount Kalaga summit; track via Progress > Collections > Meditations.

a.text: Missable outright: the trophy needs the balcony session.

b.text: Possibly missable: not confirmed the trophy needs it.

differ.call: POSSIBLY missable. Do the balcony meditation in Ch 1 to be safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting work is Jason-only and starts after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. His Target Decks list special animals; which one triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet, so work through the decks (all 15 are needed for 100% anyway).

steps.text: As Jason, meet Bret after Coffee Break (Chapter 2).
Hunt the unique animals on his Target Decks until it pops.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Any three full sets of the collectible cards scattered around Leonida finish this; each set has its own progress counter. The 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, so pick sets you will finish anyway.

steps.text: Pick up cards as you roam and watch the per-set counters.
Complete any three sets (15 of 18 for the 100% checklist).

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK phone app and scan 100 spots. Any mix counts: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures plus No Flusher tags, so there are more than 100 to choose from.

steps.text: Open WAiNK on the phone near a landmark, curiosity, sculpture or tag.
Reach 100 scans in any mix of categories.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: There are 80 challenges in the progress menu; 50 earn the trophy and 70 count for 100%, so keep going after it pops.

steps.text: Open the Challenges list and pick the quick ones first.
Reach 50 for the trophy; 70 of 80 for the checklist.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Get four stars while Jason and Lucia are together, then leave the red heat zone. Bank vault jobs always bring four stars; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good place to break line of sight. A failed attempt can simply be retried.

steps.text: With your partner along, raise the wanted level to four stars (a vault job does it).
Lose the police, e.g. in the train tunnel north of Ambrosia.
Clear the red zone; retry freely if you get caught.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With both characters, rob three shops in a row while the wanted level is still up. The three jewelry stores in north Vice City sit close together. If nothing pops after the third, give it about 30 seconds or rob a fourth.

steps.text: With your partner, rob the first north Vice City jewelry store.
Drive straight to the next two while still wanted.
No trophy? Wait ~30 s or rob a fourth shop.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: A vehicle counts as discovered when you scan it with WAiNK; you don't have to drive it. Scan new models as they pass and 100 comes naturally (200 of 277 for 100%).

steps.text: Point WAiNK at any vehicle model you haven't scanned yet.
Scan 100; keep going to 200 for the checklist.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Fill the Focus meter (landing fish tops it up by about 10% each), then trigger Combat Focus in a gang fight and drop five gang members before it runs out. Police, soldiers and civilians reportedly don't count.

steps.text: Fill Combat Focus before the fight (fishing helps).
Pick a group of gang thugs, not cops or soldiers.
Activate Focus and land 5 takedowns with an assault rifle.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet that is docked at a boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport (planes out on the airfield don't count). Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest; take off and fly about 1 km away.

steps.text: Go to VCIA terminal gates E3 or E4 and board a jet at the bridge.
Take off and get roughly 1 km from the airport.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a military tank from Mile Zero Air Station (south side, on Goose Key in south-west Mariana County) and take out enemies from inside it.

steps.text: Enter Mile Zero Air Station from its south side.
Climb into a tank and destroy hostiles with it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Pick the store's back door with it (kicking the door sets off the alarm), find the note with the safe code and empty the safe unseen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the suggested target.

steps.text: Get the Snap Gun from Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3).
At night, open the back door with the Snap Gun — never kick it.
Read the safe-code note and loot the safe without being seen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Vaults open through the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Five of the eight vaults are enough for the trophy (all eight for 100%); each one brings four stars, which doubles as Hot Together practice.

steps.text: Complete the optional That's Where The Money Is… in Chapter 4.
Rob a vault and escape the heat; repeat for five vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Hit an armored truck and get clear of the red heat zone; the trophy only pops once you are out. One pair of guides says an escaped vault robbery also counts.

steps.text: Find and rob an armored truck.
Escape the red zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray.

a.text: Only an armored-truck robbery counts (as the description says).

b.text: An escaped bank-vault robbery also triggers it.

differ.call: Rob a truck to be sure; a vault may pop it early.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map. Flying a plane or helicopter in passes over the remaining dark patches is the quickest way.

steps.text: Open the map and note the patches still in fog.
Fly over each patch until the whole map is revealed.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Nine gangs run Illegal Operations; robbing one of each is enough for the trophy. The 100% checklist wants all 39, so note which gang each site belongs to as you go.

steps.text: Rob one Illegal Operation per gang, 9 gangs in all.
Clear the rest later: 39 operations for 100%.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Derived from the official description: buy and drink a cocktail at a bar overlooking Ocean Beach. Only PowerPyx gives a method (an Apple Martini at the Ocean View rooftop bar, standing at the counter); the other guides call it unconfirmed.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View rooftop bar on Ocean Beach.
Order an Apple Martini and drink it at the bar.

a.text: Apple Martini at the Ocean View rooftop bar.

differ.call: Try PowerPyx's method; unconfirmed until others agree.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Derived from the official description: steal a car from inside a dealership and drive it out through the front window. PowerPyx names the blue Banshee in the southern Vice City showroom, which needs the Key Cloner from Chapter 3; other guides still list the method as unconfirmed.

steps.text: Get the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Chapter 3).
Take the blue Banshee in the south Vice City showroom and crash out the window.

a.text: Blue Banshee, south Vice City showroom, out the glass.

differ.call: Use PowerPyx's car; any showroom window may also work.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation first marked in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables (a watch, a shotgun and the office safe) and the trophy pops once you lose the police.
trophies.pointOfNoReturn: Marked as an optional Chapter 2 job; PowerPyx says robberies repeat.

steps.text: In Chapter 2, go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Grab the watch, the shotgun and the office safe contents.
Escape the police to unlock it.

a.text: An optional Chapter 2 job — do it then.

b.text: Not missable: robberies can be repeated.

differ.call: WATCH — rob it in Chapter 2 while it is marked.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train at fitness clubs with your partner present so both improve.

steps.text: Visit a fitness club with both characters together.
Work out until both Strength bars are full.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 actions that move your Criminal Profile. It fills passively; turn on Criminal Profile notifications to watch the count. Avoid sliding into the Irredeemable profile, which is permanent.
trophies.pointOfNoReturn: None for the trophy, but the Irredeemable profile can't be undone.

steps.text: Enable Criminal Profile notifications in settings.
Play normally until 500 profile-changing actions register.
Keep away from the permanent Irredeemable profile.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Derived from the official description only: something succeeds on a second attempt. No guide we read has confirmed the trigger; PowerPyx only speculates about the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba.

steps.text: No confirmed method: check back when guides update.
Lead to try: the Payday Loans store in Little Cuba.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: A strange event somewhere in Leonida. PowerPyx describes a random UFO sighting near the Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 AM, alone; Output Lag lists other unverified leads.

steps.text: Alone, wait near the Starlet Motel in Kelly County after 2 AM.
If nothing spawns, keep trying; it is reported as random.

a.text: UFO near the Starlet Motel after 2 AM.

b.text: Unverified: a Crosstown stairwell code or a Chapter 2 UFO side story.

differ.call: Try the motel at night first; still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Derived from the official description: knock pedestrians down with melee from a moving bike. PowerPyx puts the count at 10 within 60 seconds; the other guides have not confirmed it.

steps.text: Ride a motorbike or bicycle along a busy pavement.
Kick 10 pedestrians over within about 60 seconds.

a.text: 10 melee kicks from a bike within 60 s.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check in Chapter 3 gives the Dye Pack Jammer. Marked bills from bank and Payday Loans jobs are then sold to fences; the $250,000 total adds up across robberies, and Yasmani pays the best rate.

steps.text: Finish Credit Check (Chapter 3) for the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans to collect Marked Bills.
Sell them to fences, preferably Yasmani, until $250k.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Cumulative spending in any shops. Guns, car mods and tattoos burn through money fastest, so it usually pops on its own during the run.

steps.text: Spend on guns, vehicle upgrades and tattoos as you go.
It adds up across all shops to $100,000.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: The Vice City Real Estate phone app opens after Daily Driver in Chapter 2. Buy all eight garages listed for sale (about $160,000); the four garages the story gives you don't count.

steps.text: Finish Daily Driver (Chapter 2) to unlock the real-estate app.
Buy all 8 garages for sale, about $160k in total.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission unlocks the Scooter Bros app. Each registration at his Port Gellhorn garage costs money and needs a free garage slot, so it pairs well with Little Boxes.

steps.text: Play Moses' Chapter 2 mission to unlock Scooter Bros.
Bring 10 cars to his Port Gellhorn garage with free slots ready.
